name: Subtalar Instability
definition: Pathological instability of the subtalar joint, often following inversion trauma and sometimes overlapping clinically with chronic lateral ankle instability.

redFlags.item: Subtalar dislocation history with severe degeneration

investigations.principle: Stress imaging, CT or MRI is used selectively because diagnosis is often clinical and challenging.
investigations.MRI: Use MRI when neural, soft-tissue, labral, tendon, ligament, infection, occult injury or other condition-specific assessment requires it.
investigations.radiographs: Use radiographs and/or CT according to the condition-specific diagnostic pathway.

amber: Persistent mechanical instability may require specialist stabilization.
red: Urgent red-flag features override routine conservative or Ayurvedic pathways.

ayurvedaFramework.text: Pada/Gulpha Sandhi asthirata phenotype may be documented.

patientEducation.summary: Pathological instability of the subtalar joint, often following inversion trauma and sometimes overlapping clinically with chronic lateral ankle instability.
patientEducation.urgent: Seek urgent assessment for acute neurovascular compromise, major trauma, rapidly progressive weakness, suspected serious infection, airway/vascular symptoms, unreduced dislocation or other listed red flags.
